    "4fef15f7:  ;\n ;DGJXA5 ; Interface Entry for Set Current Transfer Dates Actions\n ; -- Allows editing which dates are relevant for capturing patient transfer details\n ;\n ; Variables\n ;  DG  Piece for looping through multiple values\n ;  DE(1)  Holds value of 'Last Transfer Date'\n ;  DE(2)  Holds value of 'Message Text'\n ;\n ; Called By\n ;  ^DGUTL1 (Current Transfer Dates main menu option)\n ;",
    "de3a5e57: ;Jump to label 'BEGIN' after doing set DIC logic",
    "08ae736c: ;Set DIC variables for FileMan and clear any previously stored values",
    "1049c5a4: ;Store value of 'LAST TRANSFER DATE'",

    "ea8c94ef: ;Kill variable and quit",

    "e47ee11c: ;Quit this routine",

    "a391e549: ;For certain data value types, branch to word-wrapping routine",
    "0a2909ed: ;For non-editable fields, display message and quit",

    "a0e389f7: ;If the user chooses to exit without saving changes.",
    "b3786338: ;Increment the level of the writer auxiliary variable (DQ).",
    "e902de2f: ;Branch to the next question based on the current level (DQ).",
    "d1e6eee5: ;If there is a delayed expression (DE) at the current level, go to the previous question (PR), otherwise write the current question (W) and process transform (TR).",
    "7e722885: ;If no input (X is null), go to the next question (A) unless certain conditions are met: DV contains 'R' (required), X is false (0), or D (data) is negative.",
    "f663de3f: ;If the input starts with '?', go to the extended help (QS). If the input starts with '^', execute D (data transform) and branch to ^DIE17.",
    "b5e7304f: ;If the input is '@', execute D and branch to Z^DIE2.",
    "e592f092: ;If the input is a space and DV allows DINUM, and the user has a DINUM value defined, set X to that DINUM value. If DV doesn't allow computed fields or word-processing fields, write the DINUM value.",
    "17b71ec8: ;If DV is a form feed, go to M^DIE17. If DV is a VARIABLE pointer, go to ^DIE3. If DV is not a set of codes, go to P (process parameters). If there is code for a COMPUTED-FIELD, execute it. Set % to the first semi-colon piece of the COMPUTED expression and Y to X. If % is not null and there is COMPUTED code, execute it. If no word-processing field, write %. Go to V.",
    "641e3ab2: If the data matches any Screen ('S') specified in the DATA DEFINITION FILE (#.87) (DICS('S')) then execute the Screen Logic.  Quit if no match found.",
    "1295abac: If no DB Node exists, then display anything that was not matched by the Input Transform. Otherwise, set X to the data part of the input value (everything after the first colon).",
    "30df5ee2: If the Input Transform includes a 'P' (Pointer), then set the file DIC is pointing to and determine if the Pointer is to an Entire File (set DIC(0)=\"NM\") or to an Entry in a File (set DIC(0)=\"EN\"). If the Input Transform includes a 'L', then set DLAYGO to the file number that the Pointer may be pointing to. If no Wildcard ('*') is specified, then execute DIC Lookup to obtain the Internal Entry Number of the Pointer Value. Set X to the Internal Entry Number. Set DIC to the Input Variables File to allow editing of the selected value.",
    "19bcaa4b: If the Input Transform does not include 'N' (Numeric), then go to the Computed Code ('V'). If the Input Transform is for a Date ('D'), then Exclude any dates with a precision greater than 24 decimal places (microseconds). Kill the input value if it exceeds the precision.",
    "29d67077: If the Input Transform specifies a numeric value and the value contains a decimal point, then remove any leading or trailing zeros from the decimal portion of the value. If the trailing decimal portion is all zeros, then remove the decimal point.",
    "7c5a5cce: Kill YS and execute the code in CAPTION DQ.",
    "4ecca55d: Kill DIC('S'), DLAYGO. If X is defined and not null, set DG(DW)=X. If DV contains 'd', set ^DISV(DUZ,'DIE',DLB)=X. Go to label A.",
    "d8421d09: If not in taskman, write '??'. If DB(DQ) is defined, go to label Z^DIE17.",
    "740f1236: Set X='?BAD'.",
    "8d764559: Set DZ=X, execute label D, execute QQ^DIEQ, go to label B.",
    "4f18495e: Set D=DIFLD, DQ(DQ)=DLB_U_DV_U_DU_U_DW_U_$P($T(@('X'_DQ)),' ',2,99). Quit.",
    "4d2dc565: If DE(DQ) is undefined, execute label O. If X is not '@', go to RD. If DV does not contain 'R' and X='@', go to A. If X='@', set X=Y and go to N.",
    "1acd4f7d: Set DG=DV, Y=DE(DQ), X=DU. If DQ(DQ,2) is defined, execute DQ(DQ,2). Go to RP.",
    "594e34ad: If DG contains 'P' and ^(0) exists in file X, set X=$P(^(0),U,2). If ^(Y,0) does not exist, go to RP. Otherwise, set Y=$P(^(0),U), X=$P(^DD(X,.01,0),U,3), DG=$P(^(0),U,2) and go to R.",
    "cfbdbf71: If DG contains 'V', Y is numeric, $P(Y,';',2) contains '(', and @(U_$P(Y,';',2)_'0)') exists, set X=$P(^(0),U,2). If ^(+Y,0) does not exist, go to RP. Otherwise, set Y=$P(^(0),U). If ^DD(+X,.01,0) exists, set DG=$P(^(0),U,2), X=$P(^(0),U,3) and go to R.",
    "f2ab1604: ;If global path starts with 'D', process X-ref on ^DD. If starts with 'S', set Y to piece after semi-colon.",
    "e9e01222: ;Call the reader, if it returns go to 'A' label unless DV>1 and the Computed Field code failed, then go to ^DIE17.",
    "e4b34679: ;If reader returns and DV doesn't contain 'I' or '#', branch to RD (presumably Read).",
    "9be1c406: ;Call the editor E^DIE0, if it returns go to RD, otherwise PR (presumably the prompt reader).",
    "7ba6030e: ;Quit.",
    "58fa0d19: ;Set up variables for the MUMPS cross-reference processor.",
    "7bf6ee83: ;If DG defined as >9, call F^DIE17 first, get record, set DQ=1, window=0;11, inst=R*P393.2', no DU, lbl=STATUS, field=.11.",
    "57a311eb: ;DU is set to the global reference for the 393.2 file.",
    "8a422401: ;X is set to the value of DGJTST.",
    "88a656e8: ;Y is set to the value of X.",
    "4874c916: ;If X is null, perform additional processing. Otherwise, store the value of X in the database record and perform additional processing if certain conditions are met.",

    "fa545827: ;End of subroutine X1.",

    "1c7d9569: ;End of subroutine X2.",
    "1b5105ad: ;Branch to the entry point of DIE17."
